prompt: CHALLENGE: Vitamin E (α-tocopherol) is a biological antioxidant. By what mechanism does it protect cell membranes from lipid peroxidation?

options.label: Its phenolic O–H donates H• to lipid peroxyl radicals (ROO•), giving ROOH and a resonance-stabilized tocopheroxyl radical that is too unreactive to propagate.
It activates an enzyme that cleans up radicals.

explanation: Phenols with electron-rich rings are excellent H-atom donors because the resulting phenoxyl radical is heavily resonance-stabilized across the ring. The tocopheroxyl radical is persistent enough that it waits for another ROO• rather than propagating a new chain — chain-breaking antioxidant.
